title: Numerical analysis for leaky-integrate-fire networks under Euler-Maruyama
summary: Leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) networks are standard reduced models for spike-based neural dynamics and a natural substrate for neuromorphic computation. We study time-driven Euler--Maruyama simulation of current-based LIF networks with exponentially decaying synapses and instantaneous resets. Because diffusion acts through the synaptic current rather than directly through the voltage, numerical error is concentrated at threshold events.
